title: The Good Shepherd
traveler_why: Willow is the warm one whose gift is comfort, and Psalm 23 is the Bible’s best-loved song of comfort: a Shepherd who leads, feeds and stays close, so a child can feel safe even in the dark.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because comfort is her gift, and Psalm 23 is the Bible’s best-loved song of comfort. Willow knows that a scared heart does not need a lecture. It needs someone close. That is what David found in the dark valley: the Good Shepherd right beside him. Warm hugs and warm hearts are a little picture of the Shepherd’s care.
